visualCharacteristics.layout: Flex row, wraps; items content width with space-between and max-width 1170px >= 992px, equal flex 1 1 0 at 768-991px, one per row on mobile.
visualCharacteristics.item: margin 10px, padding-right 10px, white 14px/1.65; value paragraph bold 24px with no bottom margin, label paragraph with no top margin.
visualCharacteristics.section: Sits in a full-bleed blue (#007acb) section (section style 'blue'); the band comes from the section, not the block.

contentPattern.structure: One item per row; first paragraph is the value (bold), following paragraph(s) the label.

usage: mybeckman.in /service stat band under the hero (section style 'blue').
reuseGuidance: Use for short value + label statistic rows on mybeckman.in pages; put it in a 'blue' section for the white-on-blue look.
